description: D-01 enforce 拦截演练（Dsl 模式）：节点引用 probe_violator（model 非白名单），runner 收到 Violation 事实后以固定前缀 enforce violation: 上抛，外层驱动判别后终止整个循环且不 replan（纲领 §9.5.1 选项 B）

nodes.task: This node intentionally uses a non-allowlisted model so the evorule TCB gate rejects the instruction with a Violation fact. The driver must halt the whole loop without replanning.
